title: CycloDesk: Graphical Interface for Cyclostratigraphy with WaverideR and astrochron
description: CycloDesk is a point-and-click interface for cyclostratigraphy and paleoclimate time-series analysis that runs in the web browser on your own computer. All calculations are done by the R packages WaverideR and astrochron; every step writes its result as a text file and logs the equivalent R code, so an analysis made by clicking can be repeated in a script.
